dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Ice is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the care center, Ice has shown fearful behavior and significant kennel stress, including repeatedly jumping and slamming her body against the kennel door, barking, walking with a tense body and low tail, balking, and refusing to walk or accept treats. Ice has shown some improvement over time, becoming easier to walk, exploring with a loose body, accepting treats, and returning to her kennel without issue, but is struggling to acclimate. Medically, Ice is apparently healthy.
dog.name: Ice
